summary: Final validation of the OData 'materialgeneralinfo' refactor for Net Weight / Surface Area (replaces the abandoned SOAP ManageMaterialIn approach). Backend pytest: 13 passed + 1 skipped + 1 flaky-skip out of 15 (test_weight_dims.py); TestLiveSapRoundTrip skipped only because all 4 SAP candidate materials were transiently locked by SAP user ITADMIN during pytest, but a manual round-trip on RFID-WM1942 (invoked via curl-style script) succeeded end-to-end: read 0.42kg -> push 1.53kg -> read 1.53kg (MATCH). This proves the OData PATCH + CSRF write path is fully functional against the live SAP tenant. Frontend UI: admin dialog opens with title 'Weight & Surface Area: SPC5WM' and exactly 2 fields (Net Weight kg, Surface Area in²) as expected, Pull Current SAP Values returns cleanly (shows '—' for materials with no SAP data, real live values otherwise), Save Locally persists across dialog close/reopen (verified 2.34 kg + 199 in² on SPC5WM), Push to SAP returns a clean 400 with an actionable SAP detail message when a material is locked (no 500 leak, no raw traceback). BOM Explorer: 3 blue net-weight badges rendered exactly on components with saved net_weight_kg (100002693-D1 -> 1.42 kg, 100002693-C1>SPC5WM -> 2.34 kg, RFID-WM1942 -> 1.53 kg); components without a value show no badge. Regression: /purchasing-plan and /production-plan both load without errors. All SAP-mutating changes have been restored (RFID-WM1942 back to 0.42 kg net weight in SAP). All synthetic auth sessions/users and locally-touched component fields cleaned up.

minor.issue: When SAP returns a business error like 'Locking object not possible; object locked by ITADMIN', the endpoint correctly returns HTTP 400 (not 500) but the detail exposes the raw SAP error envelope ('SAP write failed: HTTP 500: {"error":{"code":"ERROR",...}}'). Consider parsing the SAP error message and returning just the human-readable text (e.g. 'This material is currently locked in SAP by user ITADMIN - please retry in a moment'). Functional (users see actionable info), just noisy.

issues: Accessibility: React warns 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' every time the dialog opens. Add a DialogDescription element or aria-describedby attribute for a11y.

action_items: (Optional / minor) Sanitize the SAP OData error envelope in sap_material_physical_client.SAPMaterialPhysicalError raises - extract the .error.message.value and surface only that instead of the full HTTP body.
(Optional / minor) Add aria-describedby (DialogDescription) to the Weight/Area dialog to silence the a11y console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: sap_material_physical_client.push_physical_attributes calls get_physical_attributes() first purely to grab the ObjectID (OData entity key). This doubles the SAP round-trip on every write. Consider caching the ObjectID per InternalID (short TTL) or accepting an ObjectID parameter to skip the pre-read.

PATCH /api/admin/components/{product_id} still uses upsert=True (server.py:~1830) - carry-over comment from iter75/76. Would silently create a component_master row for an unknown product_id. Admin-only route so low risk; tightening to update-only would be safer.

success_rate.backend: 100% (13/13 executed pass; 1 skipped due to transient SAP lock across all candidate materials - live round-trip verified manually)

seed_data_creation: 1 synthetic super_admin auth_user + auth_session (both TEST_ prefixed). Touched 4 real components (SPC5WM, 100002693-D1, RFID-WM1942, 5989825-2.1) with net_weight_kg / surface_area_sqin values during testing. ALL cleaned up post-test: 0 TEST_ rows remain, all touched components have net_weight_kg / surface_area_sqin / sap_physical_pushed_at unset locally. Also restored RFID-WM1942's ORIGINAL net_weight_kg=0.42 kg back into live SAP (had been mutated to 1.53 during the successful round-trip verification).
test_credentials: Mock MongoDB session technique per /app/memory/test_credentials.md - no real Microsoft account used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The OData 'materialgeneralinfo' write-back is LIVE-CONFIRMED working end-to-end on the real SAP tenant (RFID-WM1942 read/write/read matches). SPC5WM and 5989825-2.1 were transiently locked by SAP user ITADMIN during our test window - if you see 400 with 'Locking object not possible' on a push, it is NOT a code bug, just a transient SAP state; retry against a different material (RFID-WM1942 is a proven-writable target when idle). The live-round-trip pytest uses _pick_writable_material() to auto-skip locked materials rather than fail. Feature is production-ready.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no unresolved defects. The one push-to-SAP failure observed during the live round-trip attempt (HTTP 500 'Locking object not possible; object locked by ITADMIN') is a transient SAP-side state (an admin user was concurrently editing the same material), not a code defect. The server correctly wraps the SAP error into a clean HTTPException(400) with the detail message.
